label: Nested exhaustive type cutoffs give every positive rational relative frequency
paraphrase: For positive naturals a and b, the stages retaining the first a(n+1) true-type and b(n+1) false-type instances of the roster Bool x Nat form an exhaustion, and the relative frequency of the true type is a/(a+b) at every stage and in the limit. These values are exactly the rationals strictly between zero and one.
